name: Prestige International Inc.
summary: Prestige International Inc. provides business process outsourcing services in Japan and internationally. The company offers roadside assistance services for nonlife insurance companies, car manufacturers, and car dealerships; and property assistance services, such as home and parking assistance services for real estate management companies, parking lot operators, and car sharing service stations.
